target.description: Local path or clone URL of the repository to inspect. Read-only.

ref.description: Commit, tag, or branch to inspect. Defaults to the default branch head.

deployment_platform.description: Where the target actually runs. Changes applicability and severity for several rows; when absent the author halts rather than assuming.

taxonomy_override.description: Path to an 'ID Name' per-line taxonomy file. Absent means the canonical taxonomy (75 rows for INSPECT-SPEC ≥1.2; 69 rows remain valid for version-gated 1.0 reports).

depth.description: The 1.0.0 pilot reached saturation single-pass on targets up to 421 files.
